title: Route every mutating htmx endpoint from the Station Master

facts.note: Repository/stack-level fact (Bun/htmx repo with a JS/TS server), not a per-file gate: HTML and template markup in such a repo remains eligible.
Files that carry hx-* attributes, plus the Station Master module whose routes they must match. Scope is repo-wide, not limited to edited files.

values: a Station Master surface (module declaring JOURNEY_MAP) resolves in the repo
facts.note: Supplied by the existing JS validator (htmx_hypermedia_detector, checks/htmx_verb_endpoint_is_routed.mjs), which already resolves the module that declares JOURNEY_MAP by content, never by filename; if no surface resolves it returns NOT_APPLICABLE.

values: htmx_hypermedia_detector: static mutating verb endpoint not named by Station Master
facts.note: Supplied by the existing family detector (checks/htmx_verb_endpoint_is_routed.mjs), which collects EVERY statically written hx-post/put/patch/delete endpoint in the repo (changed or not) and flags one the Station Master names nowhere.

fires: Markup gains hx-post with a static path that no handler in the JOURNEY_MAP module routes.
An hx-delete/hx-put/hx-patch affordance is added to markup ahead of its server handler.
A route is removed or renamed in the Station Master while existing, unchanged markup still carries a static mutating endpoint for the old path.
A pre-existing static mutating endpoint in untouched markup is named nowhere by the Station Master (the invariant is repo-wide, independent of what was edited).
doesNotFire: Mutating verb endpoints built by interpolation (template-literal paths with ${...}).
Repos where no Station Master surface resolves (no JOURNEY_MAP, so no journey space).
Static mutating endpoints whose whole path or distinctive terminal segment the detector finds named by the Station Master (detector behaviour, not proof of routing).

given: A repo whose Station Master (the module declaring JOURNEY_MAP) resolves, with markup anywhere (changed or not) carrying hx-post/put/patch/delete with a static path
when: the Station Master resolves; every such endpoint repo-wide is checked, not only edited files
then: Ensure every such endpoint is served (routed) by the Station Master, or drop the affordance.
prefer: Add a Station Master handler matching the endpoint's method and path that checks authorization (401 on failure) and returns the fragment.
If the journey does not admit the mutation, remove the affordance from markup.
avoid: Adding a mutating button/form to markup ahead of its handler (the common cause).
Markup minting a state-advancing route the journey never admitted (a parallel, private route space); confirm, indicator and a passing test do not make it routed.
Removing/renaming a Station Master route while markup still posts to it.
Merely mentioning the endpoint's path text in the Station Master without a handler that serves that method and path.
unless: hx-get: fetching a fragment is presentation, not a journey.
Interpolated paths: skipped, not guessed (statically unresolvable bindings stay unjudged).
No Station Master surface resolves: NOT_APPLICABLE.
why: htmx declares its route space in markup; unbound, markup mints state-advancing routes the journey never admitted and affordances post into nothing. Mutations advance state, as journeys do, so they owe a route; reads do not.
evidence: htmx_hypermedia_detector (checks/htmx_verb_endpoint_is_routed.mjs) reports no unrouted mutating verb endpoint in the repo.
Every static hx-post/put/patch/delete path in the repo's markup (changed or not) is named by the module declaring JOURNEY_MAP (whole path or distinctive terminal segment).
Result is NOT_APPLICABLE only when no Station Master surface resolves.
verifier_detail: Locate the Station Master by the JOURNEY_MAP it DECLARES, never by filename.
Collect every statically written mutating verb endpoint (hx-post, hx-put, hx-patch, hx-delete) and flag one the Station Master names nowhere.

Matching is on the whole path or its distinctive terminal segment. Do NOT match on any segment: that first attempt made the rule vacuous because a Station Master importing from `./src/orders/` made every `/orders/*` endpoint look routed.

Skip endpoints built by interpolation (e.g. `/orders/${id}/void`): they cannot be compared to a server route by text, and guessing would report on correct code — same as the Vite family leaving an unresolvable trainId unjudged rather than inventing a verdict.
Do not report hx-get (MUTATIONS ONLY, DELIBERATELY): requiring every read to be routed by the Station Master would fail ordinary htmx.
Return NOT_APPLICABLE when no Station Master surface resolves — a consumer with no JOURNEY_MAP has no journey space to be outside of.
Disposition strict, severity 4: a state-changing affordance the server never routes is not suppressible and fails CI.
Term journey_space: the routes the Station Master admits, declared by the module carrying `JOURNEY_MAP`, which a state-changing htmx endpoint must be served by.

Source fix_hint snippet (verbatim): if (req.method === "POST" && path === "/orders/confirm") { if (!authorize(req)) return Response.json({ code: "unauthorized" }, { status: 401 }); return orderRowFragment("1"); }
audit: schema_version 1.1.0; kind rule; status active; introduced_in 0.2.0.
Source name: 'A mutating htmx endpoint is served by the Station Master surface (Bun/htmx)'.
Purpose: binds htmx's markup route space to the declared journey space. Member of the htmx_hypermedia_detector FAMILY detector (checks/htmx_verb_endpoint_is_routed.mjs).

Lineage: tester.htmx.verb-endpoint-coverage states the premise 'an htmx endpoint is declared in the MARKUP, so the markup is this stack's route space' — right, and also the hole. Measured on a consumer: an hx-post="/orders/void-all" carrying a confirm, an indicator and a passing test, bound to no wagon, train or interlocking, passed EVERY gated bun+htmx rule.

This is the parallel-route-space shape the hub already rejects elsewhere: the interlocking families fail a consumer that declares reachability in a second, private field instead of the declared one; htmx had the same hole with none of the teeth.

Source fix_hint code (application-specific example, generalized in prefer[0]): if (req.method === "POST" && path === "/orders/confirm") { if (!authorize(req)) return Response.json({ code: "unauthorized" }, { status: 401 }); return orderRowFragment("1"); }
